name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-site-blocks
description: The FrontX site's blocks: section-level compositions built only from @gears-frontx/ui-kit components, kit candidates, brand art and tokens, with layout-only styles and content-only props, one block per arrangement the site draws, delivered as one workspace package; plus a showcase screen that renders every block's fixture on its own route, kept out of the search index. Apply onto a project that already has template-shell, template-mfe, template-site-brand and template-kit-candidates applied.
